citationText: 57. Personal study of early hand-written B & H factory production records. Camera “production lot number 1” of 1909 or early 1910 (date unclear) consisted of two cameras, serial numbers 1 and 2; “production lot number 2” consisted of six cameras, serial numbers 3–8, dated September 22, 1910. This historian believes that these first two lots totaling eight cameras were actually the first wood model of 1909 ; this coincides with information from other sources (see also references 1, 3, 9, 10, 12, 18, 19, 21, 25, 37).
